title: fd_wielevy
description: `fd_wielevy` computes a Wiener–Lévy process, also identified in the help patch as the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process, following Xenakis’ method 3 in Formalized Music. It accepts x′ in the first inlet and y, w, and t either as a three-float list in the first inlet or as separate values through inlets 2–4, then outputs the process value.
